title: Low Dimensional Sampling under Reconstructed Constraints
summary: We study sampling from a distribution supported on an unknown compact $d$-dimensional $C^2$ manifold $M\subset\mathbb{R}^D$, observed only through i.i.d. uniform points from $M$. We reconstruct the constraint using an adaptive local-convex-hull estimator and target an ambient distribution penalized by squared distance to the reconstruction. Although the reconstructed set may be nonsmooth or fail to be a manifold, its Hausdorff accuracy alone suffices to control the Wasserstein error.
